comparison.objective: Use a physical mouse to drag a file into the green on-screen folder.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain a button press while making high-gain planar mouse motion and visually controlling a pointer.
comparison.success_condition: File dropped in the correct folder, button released, mouse upright on its mat, fingers clear, with no wrong drop, double-click, or monitor contact.
comparison.reason: It tests physical operation of a computer pointing device and screen feedback, not mechanical maintenance or damper response.
